  1. Job letters

Cookies

Cookies are small files saved on your phone, tablet or computer when you visit a website. We use cookies to make this service work.

If you only request a letter

We do not set any cookies. We do not use cookies for analytics or advertising, so there is nothing for you to accept or refuse.

To show you your confirmation page, the service stores a small amount of information in your browser instead. This is not a cookie: it is never sent to us, and your browser deletes it when you close the tab.

  • After you request a letter, we store your email address and the letter's reference so the confirmation page can show them.
  • If we cannot find your record, we store the name and employee ID you entered so the next page can tell you what did not match.

Both are deleted as soon as the page has used them. You can clear them at any time by closing the tab.

If you sign in to the admin console

Staff who sign in to the admin console get one strictly necessary cookie. It keeps the service working and is not used to track anyone.

  • moe_admin_session: remembers that you have signed in, for up to 8 hours. Cleared when you sign out.
